dataSource: City of Kansas City Permits - CPD Dataset (Socrata dataset ntw8-aacc), queried live

coverage.since: Historical records 2010-2024, plus any newer records the city has resumed publishing

notes: Pulled live from the City of Kansas City's public permit system on every search, not a static extract — coverage reflects whatever the city has published as of your search.
Matched by address prefix against the city's combined address field.
The city paused new permit data publishing in March 2024 for server updates; historic records from 2010-2024 remain fully queryable.
summary: Kansas City is covered by a live query against the city's public Permits dataset, matched by address as you search.
